'''Lepwalk C'han''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He lived in a small abode on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lepwalk C'han was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FonatF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Lepwalk C'han was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Portable Deep Fryer|"Portable Deep Fryer" collection]] introduced with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|Chapter 9]],"<ref>{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67692&month=042008|text=Weekly Picks – 4/3/08 - 04/03/2008}}</ref> published on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>
